name: Buñuel in the Labyrinth of the Turtles

paragraphs.text: Buñuel in the Labyrinth of the Turtles () is a 2018 adult animated biographical drama film directed by Salvador Simó and written by Simó & Eligio R. Montero based on the graphic novel Buñuel en el laberinto de las tortugas by Fermín Solís, about film director Luis Buñuel making the 1933 film Land Without Bread. In August 2019, it was shortlisted as one of the three films in contention to be the Spanish entry for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film at the 92nd Academy Awards, but lost to Pain and Glory.

Buñuel in the Labyrinth of the Turtles has an approval rating of 98% on review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, based on 51 reviews, and an average rating of 7.1/10. The website's critical consensus states, "Thrillingly imaginative and appropriately surreal, Buñuel and the Labyrinth of the Turtles open an alluringly dreamlike window into the life of a brilliant artist. Metacritic assigned the film a weighted average score of 74 out of 100, based on 12 critics, indicating "generally favorable reviews".
